title: Deeper/broader modeler carrier-loss and generated-polyhedron route
scope: Compare current open-source source declarations and reported loss shapes across DWG/DXF modeler read, carrier, write, and consumer routes.
Identify a locally generatable scratch-only SAT/SAB polyhedron candidate with independently calculated expectations.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 implementation readiness without treating peer reports or generated carriers as universal semantic evidence.

method.evidenceRule: Mutable documentation and issue reports establish only declared scope or a version-specific reported failure shape. No current peer behavior, exact compatibility, geometry semantics, or native acceptance is established without pinned execution.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG AcDs source and issue revision boundary
evidence.observed: NEWS describes AcDsPrototype_1b as incomplete and says R2013+ SAB extraction was not reliable, with a brute-force extraction route. Current master exposes an R2007+ AcDs section-reading path. Issue #1411 reports geometry loss on LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at commit 8a1ae764. These do not resolve whether a later source revision handles the same generated case or all owner/key/body mappings.
doesNotEstablish: That current LibreDWG master has no AcDs reader
That the issue's exact failure remains in a later revision
Complete AcDs DataStorage parsing or entity-to-payload ownership
SAT/SAB semantic validity or B-rep correctness
evidence.planUse: At the existing optional composed checkpoint, pin source and binary, use a local profile-matched generated input, and record section, owner/key association, exact payload disposition, and strict reread separately.

evidence.topic: Silent 3DSOLID and REGION DXF writer omission failure shape
evidence.observed: The issue remains open as of review and reports ACadSharp 3.4.9 reading DWG 3DSOLID/REGION entities but omitting them silently during DXF writing, including solids in blocks. The cited customer drawings are not published. Linked PR #1240 is also open; it proposes ACIS-dependent Region, CadBody, and Solid3D writing, depends on ACDS/ACIS schema-storage refactor #1174, and its branch is not deployed. PR #1174 remains open; an Aug 12 comment reported that a branch-tested DxfAcdsDataSectionTests.ReadAcdsDataAttachesAcisPayloadToOwnerEntity test failed with NotImplementedException in readAcdsRecord, while ten other ACDS tests passed. This is historical feedback from that tested branch revision, not current CI status.
doesNotEstablish: A current ACadSharp master or release defect
A merged or deployed fix from PR #1240
Passing CI, release behavior, or successful native interoperability from the open PR
Current head behavior of the owner-payload attachment path from the historical PR #1174 comment
A reusable public customer drawing or fixture
evidence.planUse: Audit local modeler writer dispatch and require source-handle disposition in modelspace and nested blocks. Never fetch or add the customer drawings; do not accept entity/block counts as proof that bodies survived.

evidence.topic: ezdxf as a bounded carrier generator and structural observer
evidence.observed: The stable docs describe parsing/authoring only simple known ACIS structures, not arbitrary ACIS editing and not a kernel. They document body_from_mesh() and export_dxf() for polyhedra, and state their polyhedral output loads in Autodesk/BricsCAD for DXF R2000-R2010 SAT and R2013-R2018 SAB. The ACIS browser can expose raw payload, while the drawing add-on does not render ACIS or provide a 3D engine.
doesNotEstablish: A local execution or exact installed-package behavior
Independent reader or kernel acceptance of bytes generated by ezdxf
Curved B-rep semantics or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Conditionally admit one exact-pinned, temporary asymmetric polyhedron input. Capture version, profile/signature, producer parameters, payload hash, and independent analytic expectations. Select a decoder only if its admitted profile matches the exact bytes.

evidence.observed: Official documentation lists explicit entity subsets for C++ and legacy DXF importers and says embedded ACIS/SAT solids cannot currently be read. A maintainer response describes the ACIS blob as proprietary/undocumented and closed the request as not planned.
evidence.planUse: Keep native FreeCAD qualification scoped to its named 2D/explicit-entity converter and importer route. ACIS semantics need a separately named, permitted, profile-matched reader/kernel route.

nextLocalOrder: Complete existing generated block/INSERT history-proxy closure assertions after strict re-export/readback when uncovered.
Inventory local read dispatch, API representation, and ASCII/Binary writer cases for 3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, and supported SURFACE records.
Add only a concrete local writer-omission or silent-loss regression, recording one disposition per source modeler handle.
At the existing composed checkpoint only, generate one exact-pinned scratch polyhedron and compare exact carrier extraction before optional profile-matched semantic decoding.
implementationReadiness.fastValidation: Build the owning target, run its direct selector and existing focused CTest, then scoped git diff --check. No new CTest lane, per-slice peer execution, persistent external fixture, or routine full-suite run.
implementationReadiness.selfUnblock: If ezdxf, a matching independent decoder, a kernel, or native platform is unavailable, record NOT_RUN/DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and continue the next local carrier/owner/source-disposition slice.

limitations: GitHub issues and project documentation are mutable; peer source commits and binaries were not pinned or executed.
The ezdxf-generated polyhedron route is proposed only; it has not been run or admitted as a decoder/consumer oracle.
No current peer or native platform result establishes semantic ACIS/AcDs support.
Historical count discrepancies remain; the working summary is 142 findings / 78 subplans, with older entries retaining prior counts.
